item.title: Town council member’s brother confirmed as planning commissioner
item.description: Hempstead Town Council Members approved the hiring of Vincent Muscarella as full-time commissioner for the town’s planning and economic development department at its Feb. 24 meeting. Muscarella is the brother of Michael Muscarella, Hempstead’s 2nd District council member, said Brian Devine, the town’s communications director. . item.description: The Great Neck Bruins 12U Gold team captured the Long Island Amateur Hockey League championship Sunday, Feb. 22, with a win over The Rinx at Aviator Sports and Events Center in Brooklyn.
